Do you love turning complexity into clarity, aligning teams, and shaping product experiences that genuinely make people’s lives easier? If so, we’d love to meet you!</p> <p>We build software that takes the stress, chaos, and friction out of managing a health practice. As our newest Product Owner, you’ll play a pivotal role in translating vision into action, turning customer needs into features and driving product outcomes that truly matter.</p> <p>You’re someone on the rise - intelligent, opinionated (in the best way), and ready to make an impact. You’re not easily swayed, and you’re happy to take a stand when it serves the customer and the product. You connect dots, ask great questions, and care deeply about delivering value. If that sounds like you… read on!</p> <h3>You’re Excited To</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Be the voice of the customer; advocate for user needs and pain points.</p> </li> <li> <p>Maintain deep customer understanding and share insights with key teams.</p> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>Translate product priorities into clear, prioritised &amp; actionable items for your team</p> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>Work closely with engineering to understand constraints, dependencies, and system behaviour</p> </li> <li> <p>Build alignment, trust and collaborate seamlessly across Product, Engineering, and Customer Support</p> </li> <li> <p>Ensure continuous delivery of value; own the lifecycle from discovery to post-launch iteration.</p> </li> <li> <p>Guide product decisions that make a real difference for the people using Zanda every day</p> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>Communicate clearly across async and real-time channels.</p> </li> <li> <p>Surface risks early and drive grounded, data-informed decisions.</p> </li> <li> <p>Contribute to risk-based analysis of product changes and support identification of potential vulnerabilities</p> </li> </ul> <h3><br>What You Bring to the Team</h3> <h3>Experience&nbsp;</h3> <ul> <li> <p>2+ years of hands-on product ownership experience (SaaS experience an asset)</p> </li> <li> <p>Proven ability to translate customer pains into clear requirements and impactful improvements</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong understanding of agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) and product development architecture</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience in another role before moving into product - a Customer Success, Support, or similar background is a real plus</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrated experience working with remote, cross-cultural teams across multiple time zones</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Skills&nbsp;</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Customer Insight &amp; Discovery - understands user needs, pain points, and motivations.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strategic Thinking -&nbsp; connects decisions in your product area to customer needs and team priorities</p> </li> <li> <p>Data-Informed Decision Making - uses data to guide choices, even with ambiguity.</p> </li> <li> <p>Clear &amp; Adaptive Communication - complex to simple, and with the audience in mind.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Cross-Functional Collaboration -&nbsp; works effectively across teams and builds influence through trust, not title.</p> </li> <li> <p>Prioritisation - confidently prioritises what drives the most impact and eliminates noise.</p> </li> <li> <p>Technical Fluency - understands enough to engage meaningfully with engineering.</p> </li> <li> <p>Risk Identification &amp; Mitigation - surfaces risks early and makes grounded decisions.</p> </li> <li> <p>Problem Solving &amp; Critical Thinking - breaks down complexity into clear, actionable steps.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Traits&nbsp;</h3> <ul> <li> <p>High Ownership Mindset - proactive and treats the product like a business.</p> </li> <li> <p>Collaborative &amp; Empathetic - builds trust quickly and embraces diverse perspectives.</p> </li> <li> <p>Calm Under Pressure - steady when navigating competing priorities or ambiguity.</p> </li> <li> <p>Adaptable &amp; Curious - thrives in fast-changing environments, shows interest in emerging technologies - particularly AI and automation.</p> </li> <li> <p>Integrity-Driven - transparent, reliable, and grounded in facts, not ego.</p> </li> <li> <p>Opinionated (in the right ways) – advocates confidently for what's right for the customer, and isn't easily swayed.</p> </li> <li> <p>Energetic &amp; Self-Starter - brings momentum, enthusiasm, and a bias for action.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strategic Yet Practical - able to zoom out and zoom in fluidly.</p> </li> <li> <p>Growth Oriented - desire to grow, stretch, take on more responsibility, and help influence direction.</p> </li> <li> <p>Customer-Obsessed - curious, empathetic, and motivated to solve real user problems.</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<img src="data:image/png;base64,
